title: cyperus tabularis var. humilis
intro: Cyperus tabularis var. humilis, commonly known as Dwarf Cyperus or Small-flowered Flat-sedge, is a low-growing, perennial plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues, including respiratory problems, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus tabularis var. humilis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant effects, which help to alleviate symptoms such as coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
